name: Proof of Mettle
description: Baelor the Blacksmith is a grump and won't talk to me. He mentioned needing 'Shadow-Iron Ore' from the old, collapsed mine. Maybe if I can retrieve some, he'll see I'm not useless.

1.name: Get the task from Baelor
1.description: Speak to Baelor and try to get him to open up.

fail_response.content: What do you want? I'm busy. Don't waste my time, adventurer.

2.name: Retrieve Shadow-Iron Ore
2.description: Baelor needs 3 pieces of Shadow-Iron Ore from the collapsed mine. It's dangerous, but it's the only way he'll respect me.
